# cidaas_notification_provider_config (Resource)

`cidaas_notification_provider_config` stores the credentials for a `cidaas_notification_service_setup` via `notifications-srv`. `config_data` is the wizard-shaped JSON payload cidaas expects (`commProvider`, `commMethod`, `schemaData`); verification happens manually in the cidaas service-desk UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cidaas_notification_service_setup" "ses_email" {
  name                  = "SES Email"
  service_id            = "custom-ses-email"
  communication_methods = ["email"]
}

resource "cidaas_notification_provider_config" "ses_email" {
  service_setup_id = cidaas_notification_service_setup.ses_email.id

  config_data = jsonencode({
    commProvider = "custom-ses-email"
    commMethod   = "email"
    schemaData = {
      accessKeyId     = var.ses_access_key_id
      secretAccessKey = var.ses_secret_access_key
      region          = "eu-central-1"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_data` (String, Sensitive) JSON-encoded provider credentials, e.g. `jsonencode({ commProvider = "custom-ses-email", commMethod = "email", schemaData = { ... } })`.
- `service_setup_id` (String) The `cidaas_notification_service_setup` ID this config belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `service_setup_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cidaas_notification_provider_config.ses_email b4ba52ae-87b3-4967-93b6-8e6ae8f39922
```
